"""Conversion from legacy ACCT_MASTER rows to modern account records."""


def _float_or_zero(value: str) -> float:
    """Convert a legacy numeric string, treating blank values as zero."""
    return 0.0 if value == "" else float(value)


def _date_or_none(value: str) -> str | None:
    """Convert YYYYMMDD legacy dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD."""
    if value == "" or value == "00000000":
        return None
    return f"{value[:4]}-{value[4:6]}-{value[6:8]}"


def convert_account(row: dict) -> dict | None:
    """Convert one legacy ACCT_MASTER CSV row to a modern account record."""
    if row.get("DEL_FLG", "") == "Y":
        return None

    return {
        "account_id": row.get("ACCT_ID", ""),
        "name": row.get("ACCT_NM", ""),
        "account_type": row.get("ACCT_TYP", ""),
        "sic_code": row.get("SIC_CD", ""),
        "region": row.get("REGION_CD", ""),
        "annual_revenue": _float_or_zero(row.get("ANN_REV", "")),
        "currency": row.get("CURR_CD", "") or "USD",
        "owner_id": row.get("OWNER_UID", ""),
        "team_code": row.get("TEAM_CD", ""),
        "credit_limit": _float_or_zero(row.get("CRED_LIMIT", "")),
        "credit_hold": row.get("CRED_HOLD", "") == "Y",
        "created_date": _date_or_none(row.get("CREATE_DT", "")),
        "updated_date": _date_or_none(row.get("UPD_DT", "")),
    }
